title: Programming from Zero
summary: Never written code before? Start here. Learn what a program is and write your first ones in C: output, variables, functions, decisions and loops.
description: This track assumes nothing. You'll learn what a program actually is, how a compiler turns your text into something a CPU can run, and the five building blocks every program is made of. By the end you'll write FizzBuzz and programs that read input — in C, the language most of the world's operating systems are written in.
